dependency_reason: The complete before link content pass has no spoiler resolution step.

After the table pass selects single pipe cell boundaries, each cell is processed through the normal inline path. This function then pairs unresolved two character pipe marks as spoiler delimiters when MD_FLAG_SPOILERS is enabled.
Resolved two character pipe marks produce spoiler span callbacks.
md_html forwards the supplied parser flags to md_parse.
The output callback discards rendered output; the claim concerns behavior reachability.
